reviews.text: Very good service
Very friendly and professional 💯
Great vet, 100% recommend.

I wanted to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at São Bento Hospital for their work, dedication, and support given to my beloved Yby. ❤️

After suffering a thrombosis that blocked circulation in her hind legs, Yby lost mobility and, initially, seemed unlikely to recover. The prognosis for adaptation and a happy life was minimal—if not nonexistent.

But what happened to Yby after the accident was the result of the combined efforts of people who believed in giving time its due and, above all, giving life a chance.

Despite everything pointing in the opposite direction, Yby had the opportunity to undergo a double amputation with the placement of prostheses, and today she can move forward with a normal, happy life full of possibilities. 🐾❤️

It was a difficult year, full of challenges, fears, and uncertainties. But looking at where we are today is an endless joy.

I am immensely grateful to everyone who was part of this journey—you know who you are. To the attendants, the nurses, especially Maria, the curious colleagues, the incredible “Team Yby” who always cheered her on, and Dr. Henrique, who made this new phase of my cat-daughter's life possible.

Every gesture, every word, every act of care, and every demonstration of affection made a difference.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for believing in her when it was so difficult to believe what was possible. ❤️

Yby is here. Happy, adapted, and ready to live.

And that, for me, is a joy that words cannot express. 🐾✨

They're great for the medical team! However, a real nightmare for follow-up care... don't even try calling them; you'll be on hold for hours listening to a recording that just keeps asking you to wait. If you're lucky enough to get through after four 30-minute calls, they'll tell you it's a busy day... but it's like that every single time. So, if you go there directly, that's fine, but if you want to contact them, don't even try! It's impossible!

If I could give 100 stars, I would. My dog, Aria, had a vet at a local clinic, but over the years she came to Sao Bento periodically and as needed, and they were always great in emergencies. In the last few months, however, Aria REALLY took a turn for the worse; after a really not-great experience at another vet hospital, I brought her to Sao Bento and they found missed diagnosis (aspiration pneumonia, mega esophagus). All of the vets Aria saw, but especially her internal medicine specialist, Teresa Rodrigues, were incredibly kind, empathetic, compassionate and dedicated. For months Teresa was in constant contact with me, always responded to my long, anxious emails, and helped me keep a close eye on Aria, making med adjustments, suggesting interventions, etc. Heartbreakingly, Aria's issues were idiopathic; there was no cure for them, and she continued to decline. I had her put down at Sao Bento and it was the most gentle, loving experience I could have asked for, in otherwise awful circumstances. Someday I will stop crying about Aria, but I will never stop being grateful for the end of life care she received at Sao Bento.

Our dog Nikita had surgery for a right malformation, and everything was truly excellent, from the reception and the operation itself to the quality of the facilities. The staff's kindness was a much-appreciated bonus.
Amazing! Dr. Sara was so kind! 😊😊 …

Excellent treatment, everyone has a great affection for the animals, it definitely makes a difference!
THANK YOU

My French bulldog suddenly stopped walking due to a spinal hernia. He underwent surgery at the São Bento Veterinary Hospital and is walking again! Excellent surgery and physiotherapy team. Rocky was very well treated! Many thanks to Dr. Henrique, Dr. Daniel and the entire team.

This clinic is not more than money-making machine that uses owners’ fear, anxiety, and love for their animals to push expensive tests and treatments.

We brought in our kitten with vomiting and diarrhea. Very quickly, we were told that there was supposedly a 90% chance he had FIP and that his chance of survival was only around 30%. While we were terrified, we were pushed toward more expensive tests and almost immediately toward buying FIP medication costing around €3,000.

Just one day of hospitalization cost us approximately €500.

Fortunately, before agreeing to such an extreme and expensive treatment, we got a second opinion.

What upsets me most is how fear was communicated and how quickly that fear was followed by increasingly expensive medical decisions.

Of course veterinarians must consider serious diagnoses, but there is a huge difference between saying “we need to rule out FIP” and telling frightened owners that the diagnosis is 90% likely, survival is only 30%, and then immediately presenting thousands of euros in further costs.

After this experience, I would never bring an animal here again.

My strong impression is that this clinic is primarily a commercial operation, constantly upselling tests, hospitalization and treatments while owners are at their most vulnerable.

In the other clinic, after a thorough examination, additional testing, and proper observation, the veterinarians concluded that our kitten was suffering from a stress-related gastrointestinal disorder. He received the appropriate supportive care, improved quickly, and literally the next day he was discharged home and was absolutely fine.

That contrast says everything for me.

If you are given a devastating diagnosis here and pressured into an expensive treatment, get a second opinion before making any major decision.
Friendly and professional staff and excellent facilities.

I am truly very grateful to everyone at this hospital, but I want to give a special thank you to Dr. Jaime Morais.

Bella and Chico are treated with so much love and care. I recommend it to everyone, but especially to Dr. Jaime. The service is full of politeness, attention, and affection that our four-legged children deserve 🙏🏻❤️🐶 Thank you so much for everything!!!!

We had a wonderful experience at this clinic! ❤️

We were seen in the evening and, from the first contact by phone, we were very well received. I even found it very positive that they informed us of the prices before we went, something that doesn't always happen and makes all the difference in an emergency.

When we arrived, we were attended to by Márcio, who was extremely kind, helpful, and attentive. He was always available to help us and accompanied us throughout the entire process.

I also want to give a special thank you to Dr. Vítor, who was super attentive and professional. He explained everything step by step, answered our questions, and made us feel very safe throughout the entire appointment.

I was quite worried when we arrived, but I felt very welcomed and calm with all the attention and care they gave us and, especially, our Lily 🥹🐶❤️ It was so good to know she was in good hands.

We left very satisfied and will certainly return to the clinic whenever we need to. I highly recommend it!

I had a terrible experience with the hospital. On August 31st, 2026, I went to the hospital with my Australian Shepherd, whose right hind leg ligament was torn. Dr. Guilherme attended to me. I had already had another evaluation done at a veterinarian closer to my home, and my dog ​​had already undergone a preliminary assessment and blood test. The doctor requested an X-ray to be more conclusive with the diagnosis, which was indeed made. The pathology and the procedure to be adopted (TPLO technique) were indeed discovered. I explained that I wanted to resolve the case as soon as possible, and the doctor told me that I would soon have an answer about the case with a budget and availability for the procedure. I also asked for the imaging exam so that I could consult with my dog's veterinarian in Brazil. Finally, on August 31st, they only sent me the images and the invoice for what I paid: €161 for a consultation, X-ray, and two medications (stomach protector and anti-inflammatory). Up to that point, I didn't question the prices at any time; I just wanted to solve the dog's problem. I sent an email requesting an update on the next steps for the dog's treatment and received no response. The next day I called to try and find out, and they told me they would remind the team to analyze the case, but that this would take two days after the initial consultation. Today, September 3rd, 2026, I called again to get some information and they told me they still have no answer, that the hospital has many surgeries and they don't know when they can do it, and that only in another two days will they be able to inform me about the budget and the availability of a surgery date. If the client doesn't call or try to contact them, nothing is communicated. I think it's honest to tell clients what's happening. I don't think it's normal to leave any animal suffering or having a poor quality of life because you are overwhelmed and cannot attend to the animal sooner. It would be good practice to explain the situation to the client and give them a letter of referral so they can find other solutions. I believe that any doctor prioritizes the well-being of their patients, and that's what I prefer to believe.
Great vet..Dr Guillermo
Many thanks to Dr. Angelina and the other professionals who cared for Benny during his final days, always with great attention and affection. It's wonderful that places like this exist.
The building is beautiful, and the service is so so good. Sara the vet is extremely knowledgeable, helpful and kind. I really recommend. Thank you for being such good support for my dog.
A magnificent scandal. Overjoyed animals being cared for by those who love them.

5 stars because I can't give 6.
I'll present the numbers to make it clear. We took our dog Tobias to the Restelo veterinary hospital. Over 8 weeks we spent €1600 on exams, consultations and medication, and we kept postponing surgery (by our own choice and with medical agreement) to try to solve the problem without this invasive intervention.
After 2 months we decided to operate. The hospital told us that we had to repeat ALL the exams to be able to have the surgery (since 2 months had already passed). We gave up.
We went to the São Bento veterinary hospital. We were always treated with professionalism, punctuality and friendliness. They used the exams done in Restelo and added a heart exam. Tobias had the surgery, it went well. We spent €450 on the surgery, consultations and medication). The surgery alone in Restelo cost €700 (run away...). I am very grateful to the Restelo hospital for taking me to the São Bento hospital. We are a foster family for abandoned animals (we have many!). We will be back. Thank you and see you soon.
The service provided by the entire team was very attentive, both the doctors and the assistants.
Good service

My dog ​​has been followed at this hospital for 11 years.

I love the work of Dr. Henrique, who put a prosthesis on her paw and made her walk again. I also really liked Dr. Angelina, the ophthalmology specialist.

The only negative experience was with Dr. Teresa.

As owners, it's normal to be more demanding with care, and there are doctors who are a little negligent. My dog ​​had contracted a skin infection, and the doctor just kept pushing it to a dermatology consultation instead of speeding things up and doing a scraping of the fur for a biopsy. There were no recent dermatology appointments; it was the first time I resorted to another veterinarian outside the hospital who did the scraping and immediately identified the bacteria.

She was followed by Dr. Sofia Claudino, but unfortunately, the doctor left the facility. Now, on recommendation, I'm seeing Dr. Jaime. I hope I chose the right doctor, who is super friendly. She was diagnosed with chronic kidney disease and will be followed here.

I think the facilities are perfect, but there are delays for urgent walk-in appointments, which I find normal, given that it's a hospital, not a clinic, and has to attend to emergencies. But sometimes it really does take a very long time. However, I also think it's a matter of speaking respectfully.

The only thing I find strange is the constant coming and going of veterinarians. But they say that's normal in a hospital setting.

We had a golden retriever examined and sterilized. The staff was attentive, everything was explained clearly. The operation was successful. The bill included only the necessary procedures and materials, no exaggeration. Thank you for your concern 🙂

I have had pets in many cities over the last 30 years and
Hospital Veterinário de São Bento is the best vet we have been to. The practice seems to be about care for animals and really fair pricing before anything else, which is rare in this business. All the vets who work for the practice have been amazing, and we recently sent our dogs to Jamie and we were so impressed with how proactive and forward thinking he was. We encountered a problem with travel paperwork, and Jamie spent extra time finding a smart workable solution. We are truly thankful to Hospital Veterinário de São Bento for setting such a great standard in animal care.

I went to H.S. Bento in the early hours of the morning and received excellent care from Dr. Vitor, who was very professional, clear, and provided great follow-up. My dog, Savi, was hospitalized for two nights. When I visited him, I was very happy to see how they interact with the hospitalized animals; all the staff were extremely kind and calm, as if they were the owners themselves (they even brushed Savi). I left feeling reassured after leaving him there. Upon discharge, I was very apprehensive about the cost, as a year ago at another hospital, for a similar situation and the same length of stay, I paid three times as much, and the care I received was completely different. I am extremely satisfied with everything. And I recommend them. Thank you to the whole team.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the São Bento Veterinary Hospital for the exceptional way they treated my dog, Bali.
After almost two months of follow-up with another veterinarian, without being able to reach a diagnosis, we went to the São Bento Veterinary Hospital today. From the first moment, we were received with enormous professionalism, attention and affection — from the reception to the nurse and the veterinarian, everyone demonstrated an irreproachable dedication to the animals.
Dr. Henrique was able to quickly identify the problem and act decisively: Bali was operated on and a sore was found already deeply embedded in his cheek, which was causing all the suffering.
In addition to the evident clinical competence, it is also worth highlighting the fact that the hospital is very well equipped, with all the necessary means for an effective diagnosis and treatment.
We left with an enormous feeling of gratitude and relief. Bali is finally recovering and we are very grateful for everything they did for him.
I recommend the São Bento Veterinary Hospital without any hesitation.
A leading hospital with top professionals! Fantastic facilities with continuous improvements! I highly recommend it!

We are immensely grateful for your 5-star review, Paula! It's gratifying to know that you trusted São Bento Veterinary Hospital to care for your pet. We are always here to offer the best care and attention necessary for the health of our four-legged friends. If you need anything or have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us. Come back anytime!

Thank you so much for your feedback! At São Bento Veterinary Hospital, we are always ready to offer the best care for your pets. We are happy to know that your experience was positive. If you need anything or have any questions, we are available to help. Until your next visit!

HVSB is more than just a veterinary clinic. It's a place where each pet is treated individually and where each owner is supported in all their decisions. Despite living far away, I will never go to another veterinarian for my animals.
I like this hospital for my dog. The place is clean and friendly staff.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review, Cristina! It's gratifying to know that we are meeting the expectations of our clients and their beloved animals. If you need anything or have any questions, we are always available to help. Your trust is very important to us!

Thank you so much for your feedback! It's gratifying to know you were satisfied with our services. We are always available to care for your pets with all the love and professionalism they deserve. If you need anything, please don't hesitate to contact us. Your trust is very important to us!

Thank you so much for your positive feedback! It's always gratifying to know that our efforts in caring for animals are recognized. We are here to offer the best care and support for your pets. If you need anything in the future or have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us. Your trust is very important to us!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! It's gratifying to know that we are fulfilling our mission of caring for our four-legged friends with dedication and professionalism. If you need any assistance or have any questions, we are always available to help. Your trust is very important to us!
Good service, I recommend it.
VIP service

Our cat, Flor, recently had a urethral obstruction, initially diagnosed at another veterinary hospital, where we were presented with an emergency surgical intervention (SUB — Subcutaneous Ureteral Bypass) as the only solution. Before proceeding with such an invasive option, we sought a second opinion from Dr. Henrique Armés, who immediately analyzed the case and explained, with great clarity and detail, the pros and cons of the procedure. This careful explanation finally gave us peace of mind and the ability to make an informed decision.

Dr. Henrique proposed trying an alternative treatment first, based on fluid therapy, explaining the associated risks with complete transparency. We transferred Flor to the São Bento Veterinary Hospital, where she was hospitalized for a week to begin this protocol. From the first minute, we realized we had made the right decision.
In addition to Flor's clinical improvements, we witnessed daily the affection, dedication, love, and professionalism of the entire team — veterinarians, assistants, reception — everyone, without exception, treated our cat as if she were their own. The empathy, sympathy, attention, and care shown to us were truly comforting during such a difficult time.
Although Flor is now considerably better, we know she is not completely free from the risk of another obstruction. But one thing is certain: even though we are about 50 km from home, this is where we will always return whenever we need veterinary help. The confidence that the São Bento Veterinary Hospital transmits to us is priceless.
I also want to highlight the exceptional conditions of this hospital — a beautiful building, restored with enormous attention to detail, designed for modern veterinary practice, and without that characteristic odor that we associate with clinics. It is located in the heart of Lisbon, but it conveys a calm and quality that is rarely found in this type of facility.
To the entire team at the São Bento Veterinary Hospital: our deepest gratitude for everything you have done and continue to do for Flor and for us. For the care, the compassion, the clarity, the humanity, and the tireless dedication. We feel truly welcomed. Thank you for existing.
I don't know what's more impressive: the welcoming atmosphere, the professionalism, or the love for life; they calm fears and treat lives as if they were their own.
Beautiful space, attentive and understanding staff and veterinarians. Truly 5 stars.
I recommend them. Diligent, efficient, and competent. I owe them the life of my dog.

I had a very difficult experience with this veterinary hospital. My cat was hospitalized with a serious clinical condition, including fever, anemia, and several days without food intake.
During the hospitalization, I felt a lack of clear and detailed communication about the clinical plan and, in particular, about nutritional support. I was told that they were waiting for the animal to feed itself independently, but it was not objectively explained to me what other concrete measures were being implemented in the absence of food intake.
There was also a delay in the availability of some test results, which increased our concern at an already very sensitive time.
I recognize that veterinary medicine has limitations and that not all cases have a favorable outcome. However, as a guardian/family, we expected more proactive follow-up, greater clarity in communication, and a greater sense of security in the clinical plan adopted.
I share this experience with respect, but also with the aim of alerting other guardians to the importance of clearly explaining all procedures and closely monitoring the clinical evolution of their animals.

"My cat was recently hospitalized at your clinic. The decor of the space is undoubtedly very appealing and well-maintained. However, the care provided to my pet was clearly insufficient and below the level of quality expected from a veterinary service of this caliber.

This failure in care had a direct negative impact on my cat's health and recovery, which left me deeply dissatisfied and concerned."

Hospital São Bento provides a high-quality service, marked by professionalism, attention, and care throughout the entire process. Throughout the whole process, I always felt confident and at ease, thanks to the team's dedication. I particularly highlight veterinarian Joana Peixoto for her exemplary care, clear communication, and constant attention to my dog. I highly recommend them.

5 stars,
First for the prompt service,
Second for the energy within the team at this clinic,
Third for the care my Kanay received,
Fourth for Samantha, who understood my situation and did her best to ensure my dog ​​received the best possible care,
Fifth for all the other things I haven't mentioned but which are just as valuable.
At first, I thought I was paying for part of the decoration of this magnificent clinic, with its beautifully crafted artwork, but in the end, I think it was simply being a gentle Gypsy that made me feel this way.
All the points mentioned above are well worth the money I spent, and of course, the good health of little Kanay, who I hope has learned that the road is for cars and not for little black dogs that can easily hide in the night.
Thank you for everything, to all of you, employees of this wonderful clinic. With love, until next time, I hope, for coffee. Many happy returns!

And now, with no strings attached, avoid this place, especially (the so called vet med) Joana Peixoto. No effort, whatsoever, to get to the source problem of your pet. Deceiving and a true lier - yes: no scratch of true in her words. Just struggling to get through the day and to justify herself with infinite words of supposed wisdom, just to get you out of there as soon as possible. Worst professional ever.

We have used this vet on a number of occasions in the last ten years. In recent times it has become intensely commercialised and profit seeking. On our last visit we were subjected to constant ‘up-selling’ by the vet trying to sell us other services. She was clearly uncomfortable doing it and it was embarrassing to see a young professional forced to act as a salesperson. I no longer trust this practice to do the best for my animal.

I am writing to express our deepest gratitude for all the love and care you have shown our Taurus. Your dedication and professionalism made all the difference in the life of Taurus and his family. We will forever remember your kindness and the love you showed Taurus. Thank you so much for everything.
With love and gratitude,
Jâmece Family
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.
Special thanks to Dr. Angelina, Dr. Henrique, Dr. Joana, Dr. Daniel, Dr. Vitor, Nurse Liliana, Nurse Samanta, but also to all the veterinarians who treated Taurus, the nurses, the assistants, and all the reception staff.
Great experience

An amazing place — exceptional client experience, highly skilled veterinarians, and truly kind people!
They understand dogs (and their humans!) perfectly — even in English.
They took care of us on Christmas Day when we had an emergency with our Westie, and their fair prices in such a luxury setting were remarkable.
We’ll never forget this experience!
Thanks 🙏🎄💫 super team
Excellent, with extraordinary doctors and staff, and top-notch facilities! The ease of parking is a plus (at the pool complex, one minute away). I love the service from the entire team!

There is a big problem here with the reception and the doctors. My dog and i waited for more than 45min after the last dog left the floor ( i waited 1:30h and i only saw 2 more dogs) and my dog never was checked. They want to bill you a lot of money but also they forget to check the dog… incredible. Not coming back again. It is also the second time i have to wait more than an hour for my dog being checked. At the end, when i was leaving there is no one in the exit and no one you can say something about the really bad moment you had with your dog. My dog was really bad and they didn’t care to give her at least a check. When i was leaving i looked for the receptionist and she told me that is COMMON to wait because i had no appointment because the doctors have appointments, so i told her NO ONE IS IN THE FLOOR WAITING OR IN APPOINTMENT I  WAS THE ONLY ONE THERE DURING THE LAST 45MIN with my dog waiting!!!!!

My dog ​​had an emergency around 1 am and we were received extremely well. Everything was impeccable, from the conscientious, patient and professional staff, to the space itself (it was night and even the animals were sleeping to the sound of calm ambient music to help them fall asleep). Thank you to the doctor who was super flexible and patient with our case. I highly recommend it.
Good service and good doctors

We have been clients of the São Bento veterinary hospital for 13 years. My cats and dog have always been cared for and undergone all procedures there. Throughout all their visits, whether they were happy or sad, they have always been attentive and extremely professional. Thank you to the hospital team for their dedication and care for us and our animals.

Grateful for the honesty of the excellent veterinary team and for the comfort and care I received after the loss of my little dog. Many thanks to everyone, especially the lady at reception, if I'm not mistaken, whose name is Carolina 🙏💯 …
Best hospital in Portugal
Great availability for consultations and quick exams, my cat needed a x-ray and was able to do it right away, appreciate the quick support.

Eternally grateful to the entire team at the S. Bento Veterinary Hospital.
I have already gone there twice in emergency situations with my Pablo and my Luna, and I have no words to express my gratitude for all the kindness and professionalism. I feel like they are a "home" for our furry friends, where they are treated with so much love.
From the reception to the medical team, my heartfelt thanks for taking such good care of my pets. ❤️‍🩹

5-star veterinary hospital!!

Fantastic team!!! 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽

Thank you so much for everything!!
An impeccable team, from diagnosis to treatment. I highly recommend them!

Really very polite and kind specialists who love animals! Today I found a dog and took it to the hospital, they scanned the chip for us and after about an hour or an hour and a half the owner of the dog came to pick it up! They actually calmed the dog down and gave him treats so he wouldn't whine!

This clinic is next to my house and my dog ​​and I came here to get vaccinated! Everything went great, but they should make the prices a little more reasonable for animals... for 2 vaccines we paid 80-100€.. it was strange, and we had a Portuguese passport.. Worth checking out.
The most careful, the most professional, and the most supportive! A huge THANK YOU to the entire team, especially Dr. Henrique.

I am a veterinarian and HVSB deserves top marks for its state-of-the-art facilities, the friendliness, excellence and professionalism of the entire team, especially Dr. Enrique Armés, Dr. Patrícia Gáyan and Dr. Joana Diogo who made themselves available to treat my dog ​​as a very special being.
Thank you very much.

I felt very welcomed by the entire HVSB team who cared for my dog, in particular Dr. Henrique Armés and the super sweet nurse from Torres Vedras (whose name I didn't remember) who demonstrated great compassion. Thank you very much.
Always excellent service.

The world's worst vet. My cat is super sick and I called this hospital twice and the secretary assured us that we could come and be seen. Then we get there and the so called "vet" answered and didn't believe me that we were told we could be there so then I had to call the secretary again and she had to come downstairs to talk to him and tell him we can be there. She takes us upstairs and the vet tries examining my cat from the waiting room rather than a patient room meanwhile there was no one else there so I asked if we could please be taken to a proper patient room. He agrees then tries examining my sick cat while she is in her carrier rather than taking her out to do a proper exam. So I had to tell him to take the cat out of her carrier because he needs to do a proper exam. That is when I realized this so called vet had never met a cat in his life as he didn't know how to hold her or touch her or anything - something was really off. Then he couldn't read the previous test results that were in Portuguese even though he is Portuguese then he told me he wants to take my cat into another room to do blood tests and I couldn't be there. I said no because you've clearly never seen a cat in your life and she is my cat therefore I need to be there. He wouldn't let me so we left. I don't know if my cat is going to make it through the night which is why we went to the vet to get her help but there was no help to be given. I really believe the vet they had there was an intern or someone practicing to be a vet because this was truly terrible.

I was at the hospital for several appointments with my Labrador, Mimi, and I want to express my gratitude to the entire team for their professionalism, especially Dr. Henrique Armes and Dr. Patrícia Gayan Sancho. We are very grateful for resolving Mimi's problems.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the São Bento Veterinary Hospital for the exemplary way they cared for our German Shepherd dog during her two weeks of hospitalization.

The dedication of the entire team made a huge difference during this delicate time. The medical team demonstrated competence, attention, and professionalism in every decision and treatment; the nursing team showed constant affection and care, treating our dog as if it were their own; and even the administrative team proved helpful and attentive, always facilitating our communication and patiently clarifying all doubts.

These were days of worry, but thanks to the commitment, humanity, and quality of service of the entire hospital, we felt confident that our friend was in safe hands.

My deepest appreciation and gratitude to all.
Many animals have been cared for at the São Bento Veterinary Hospital over many years. The technical efficiency, friendliness, services, and facilities are excellent. Absolutely recommended!

Dr. Henrique is very good, which always puts me at ease when it comes to my animals. I have a lot of confidence in the work they do at the hospital. In addition, the people are friendly and the facilities are excellent.
They will always be our top choice; they have a lot of knowledge and the best conditions, and the staff is very friendly! We love it and always come back when needed.

It's been over 10 years since my family and I entrusted our pets to Dr. Henrique and his team. Experience, professionalism, and immense dedication—they are always available to help with whatever is needed. I recommend them 100%.

Having our dog feeling uncomfortable we visited Dr. Armes in Sao Bento clinic Lisbon.
Immediately we felt comfortable with his expertise and the treatment given .
An excellent VET and team , we seen a very well equipped Clinic , I would recommend to any !
Very caring and knowlegeable staff in a beautiful and calming atmosphere. I highly recommend.

Excellent veterinary clinic in the center of Lisbon, fantastic facilities and very experienced and specialized doctors, especially Dr. Henrique and Dr. Patrícia who always cared for my dogs as if they were their own.
Excellent facilities and state of the art equipment. Team committed to innovative treatments and with strong connection to clinical research.

Excellent service. Very attentive and professional service.
Thank you!
Excellent! I recommend it! Fantastic service, location, and facilities.
Excellent service, I recommend it!

I highly recommend the Hospital Veterinário de São Bento! Great facilities with excellent professionals: always friendly, very attentive and caring, and explaining everything very well. They treat your pet as it would be their own!
P.S. We never had any problems communicating in English in the hospital.
Best veterinary hospital in Lisbon! Incredible facilities and amazing staff. Dr.Henrique very professional and kind.
The best place to treat our furry friends 🥰 We only trust Dr. Henrique and his fantastic team. If you want peace of mind and 100% security, this is the right veterinary hospital for you. …
Excellent professionals! 5 stars always for Dr. Henrique's service.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the veterinary hospital and the entire wonderful team that cared for and saved my dog. 🙏🐾
I don't have enough words to express the gratitude I feel for the professionalism, dedication, and care with which they treated him (and me, in every moment of distress).
Thank you so much to Dr. Henrique and the entire team for the excellent development work they have been doing to provide their patients (the animals) with the most advanced treatments so that they are always well!
These professionals are proof that when you love what you do, anything is possible!
Well done! Gratitude! 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

My dog ​​has been cared for by this hospital since the day she was born, and I wouldn't choose any other for all her care.
All the professionals who work at this hospital are exceptional and impeccable! My entire experience has been incredible from day one.

Thank you for the care you gave my dog, he went to the hospital in a very serious condition but thanks to the treatments he received and the love he was given he is now doing very well 🐶🐶🐶
Thank you so much 🙏 🙏🙏 …
Excellent professionals, competence, and availability of all the necessary resources for the diagnosis and treatment of our animals.
Extraordinary experience, excellent 24-hour service.

HVSB is an example of how treating animals with professionalism and care makes all the difference in their recovery and well-being. Thank you to all its professionals who are ready every day to do more and better for the well-being of each animal they treat.
A very special thank you to Dr. Henrique who is always fully available to help the animals here at home 🙏🙏🙏
Well done and well done to all the professionals of this great team!

They call or email when they have test/sample results, and they advise without any "sales" attitude, but solely in the best interest of our animal. I can’t say enough good things about Hospital Veterinário São Bento.
My 9 year old Pomeranian has been suffering with tracheal collapse for several years, but it recently became apparent that medication was no longer effective in the management of her condition and that tracheal stent surgery was the only viable option.
Given the risks of the surgery, I wanted to ensure she was in the best possible hands, so the choice to have her treated at Hospital Veterinário São Bento was an obvious one.
The surgery was a success, but there have been a variety of post operative issues (NB said issues are in no way related to the efficacy of the surgical procedure performed, rather they are common complications of this type of major surgery on a tiny, elderly and frail animal) which required repeated admission to the hospital and naturally, a lot of interaction with the staff there.
I can honestly say that I’ve never encountered such compassion, care and dedication in a veterinary practice. Everyone I’ve had contact with (and I’ve met a lot of the staff) from the hospital director, to the vets, nurses and administrative team has been unfailingly kind and accommodating.
Dr Henrique (a truly wonderful man) has always made time to fully explain procedures,  treatment plans and options. I have never doubted that he is completely committed to trying to find a path to recovery for my dog, whilst also being pragmatic about the impact her ill health is having on my family and I and also, the financial implications of a chronically ill pet. Similarly, it is abundantly clear that the nurses caring for my dog in hospital all adore her and that the feeling is completely mutual. I hugely appreciate the daily calls I receive to update me on my dog’s condition and that I am able to visit whenever it’a appropriate.
I honestly don’t know what the outcome will be for my dog, but I’m certain that the team at the hospital will explore every available option to aid her recovery and I take comfort from the fact that she’s received exemplary and unparalleled care thus far.
As an aside, I’m baffled by reviews accusing the hospital of refusing to speak English with pet owners and even of xenophobia(?!), as this couldn’t be further from my experience. I can only assume that any reluctance would be based on practical concerns about ensuring that complex medical information is conveyed with the necessary precision, which is hard to do in one’s mother tongue, let alone a second language. I’d also point out that we are in Portugal, where the language is Portuguese, not English and that accordingly, it’s extremely entitled and completely unreasonable to expect everyone to speak English.

We had a profoundly traumatic experience at the São Bento Veterinary Hospital (HVSB), which unfortunately resulted in the death of our kitten.

The kitten was initially taken to this hospital due to inflammation of the anal sacs. During the first consultation, the veterinarian failed to diagnose the condition and refused to perform a physical examination, compromising the identification and treatment of the problem. In the following two consultations with another veterinarian, the inflammation was finally diagnosed and treated. However, this hospital has a practice of placing unvaccinated cats in direct contact with the examination table. Unfortunately, the kitten licked a liquid from the table, resulting from the secretion of the anal sacs released during treatment, which was confirmed as the likely route of contagion for feline panleukopenia—a virus transmissible between cats and through contaminated and poorly disinfected surfaces. It is likely that the contagion occurred by licking the liquid, or later, by licking her paws after contact with the contaminated surface. This hypothesis is further reinforced by the fact that we live in an apartment without outdoor access, protected by screens, where our adult cat, vaccinated and healthy, already lived. At the second consultation with the veterinarian, although it had been previously agreed that the vaccine would be administered, she refused, claiming that we hadn't informed the reception – which we did.

At all consultations, the three veterinarians placed the kitten directly on the examination table, despite us always informing them that she was not yet vaccinated.

At the 4th consultation, already showing symptoms consistent with panleukopenia, a 3rd veterinarian refused to perform blood tests, despite our suggestion. After an inconclusive X-ray, the kitten was sent home without a diagnosis. This professional, like the previous two, also placed her directly on the examination table. The condition worsened hours later. We returned to the hospital that same day, but she died a few hours after being admitted.

The suspicion of panleukopenia was only mentioned after the death—a common and fatal disease in unvaccinated kittens, against which the first vaccine is given.

The clinical director stated that he himself would perform the necropsy (autopsy for animals) and strongly emphasized that it might not be conclusive. It was then that we decided to take our kitten's body to the National Institute of Agrarian and Veterinary Research (INIAV) to ensure impartiality. We asked the HVSB (Veterinary Hospital of Bragança) to expressly indicate the search for panleukopenia on the form sent to INIAV, but the document was sent twice without this search. Only on the third time, after our continuous intervention, did the HVSB include the request. Incompetence or another reason? The result confirmed: feline panleukopenia.

We filed a formal 10-page complaint with the Professional Ethics Council of the OMV (Order of Veterinarians), with 9 attached documents. The response was limited to stating in one sentence that no action would be taken, attaching only the clinical director's reply, which sought to ridicule the facts presented without assuming any responsibility and didn't even spell our other cat's name correctly.

We were not surprised by this attitude. On the very day of the kitten's death, we met with the clinical director, who demonstrated complete insensitivity. He used a harsh and unempathetic tone, sighed repeatedly, and even stated that he felt "like a victim," telling us to be careful with our words, referring to the case of a friend who gave up her profession. Even worse, he said: "panleukopenia is a virus that travels in the air"—which is false. The virus is not aerosolized; this is a basic fact for any professional in the field.

Later, when we took our other cat to the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine (FMV) in Lisbon and reported what had happened, the veterinarian was visibly shocked. We were informed that, at FMV, it is standard practice to place a sterilized tissue on the examination table specifically for unvaccinated cats, as a preventative measure against the risk of contagion of infectious diseases — a basic biosecurity measure ignored at HVSB.
